note: Roster registry for glyph-sequence-perception. Adapter specs copied from the archived judges-v1.json; family and mode added. family = LLM family for universality; mode = sheet (several presentations per call) or single (one per call).

context_residue.claude: claude -p with --tools '' --strict-mcp-config (no MCP), --setting-sources '' and --system-prompt override. Verified 2026-10-03: the judge sees no CLAUDE.md content and nothing about glyphs; it DOES see an account-level note giving the user's email address (asked directly, sonnet-5-5 reported it). Not removable from this CLI; judged harmless to glyph perception.
context_residue.grok: grok -p under an isolated HOME holding only a symlink to ~/.grok/auth.json and a minimal config (no arch-expert agent, no ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, no skills, no memory); --system-prompt-override, --tools '', no subagents, no web. Verified 2026-10-03: `grok inspect` shows 0 project instructions; judge reports no Joseph/glyph context. Grok's own built-in harness preamble (~13.5k input tokens) remains and cannot be stripped from the CLI.
context_residue.codex: codex exec under an isolated CODEX_HOME holding only a symlink to ~/.codex/auth.json (no AGENTS.md, memories, rules, skills); --ephemeral, read-only sandbox. No system-prompt override exists, so the study system line is prepended to the user turn. Codex's built-in agent preamble (~13k input tokens) remains. Verified 2026-10-03: judge reports no Joseph/glyph context.
context_residue.agy: Gemini via the Antigravity CLI (agy -p), run in an empty cwd; HOME not isolated (agy's knowledge/brain stores exist under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli). Verified 2026-10-03: judge reports no Joseph/glyph context. Study system line prepended to the user turn; agy harness preamble (~12k tokens) remains.
context_residue.ollama: local /api/chat with the study system prompt only; temperature 0, seed 0.
context_residue.llamacpp: local llama-server, study system prompt plus the model's reasoning-strength line; no tools.
